verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents that backups/sync can be encrypted with a user password (docs-9, docs-17, docs-18) and that vault storage location is user-controlled, but the encryption is presented as optional ('we encourage you to do that') rather than guaranteed end-to-end by default, and there is no detailed technical whitepaper describing key derivation, zero-knowledge architecture, or threat model. Community discussion (2fas-comm-1) explicitly questions whether backups to iCloud/WebDAV truly avoid vendor/server trust, further undercutting a strong E2E claim. missing for 10: a dedicated cryptographic design document (algorithms, key derivation, zero-knowledge proof), confirmation that encryption is mandatory/default rather than opt-in, and independent security audit corroboration.
